rust_summary: living_knockback_v2: raw knockback with the attacker's entity id and held items, including armor-stand sweeps.
doc_summary: living_knockback_v2: raw strength before resistance, attacker network id (0 if unknown), the attacker's held main-hand and off-hand stacks (a player's selected and off-hand stacks, a mob's main hand; none when unknown), and armor-stand sweeps. The unchanged v1 hook runs first on its existing paths; cancellation from either wins. Bundles need hooks API @API:living_knockback_v2@.
